heldout_fertile_bands.F1_G4_top_S1_random_unbiased: G4 top fertile band; q3/r1 S1 random-unbiased generator.
heldout_fertile_bands.F2_high_relation_asymmetry_structural: q3/r1 structurally relation-complete rules with relation_degree=2, depends_center=true, left_right_asymmetry>=0.35, output_entropy in [1.0, 1.585].
heldout_fertile_bands.F3_near_validation_PRA_structural: q3/r1 S4/S1-like relation-complete rules with depends_center=true, left_right_asymmetry>=0.20, output_entropy in [0.9, 1.585], not self-only.

heldout_control_bands.B1_S7_symmetric_matched: q3/r1 symmetric-control generator with coarse output-entropy/activity matching.
heldout_control_bands.B2_S8_self_only_matched: q3/r1 self-only-control generator with coarse output-entropy/activity matching.
heldout_control_bands.B3_output_distribution_matched_random: q3/r1 random tables constrained to G4 fertile-like output entropy.
heldout_control_bands.B4_high_chaos_high_frozen_barren: q3/r1 high-entropy or quiescent-preserving barren band expected to overproduce chaos/frozen artifacts.

stage1_candidate_criteria.selection: all candidate positives up to frozen per-band cap, with top stage1_score/relation_asymmetry_priority ordering only for runtime cap

success_criteria.operational_pass: fertile_primary_positive_rate >= 3x control_primary_positive_rate AND fertile_primary_positive_count >= 5 AND control_leak_count <= 1
success_criteria.strong_pass: fertile_primary_positive_rate >= 5x control_primary_positive_rate AND fertile_primary_positive_count >= 10 AND control_leak_count == 0 AND at least two fertile bands independently produce positives
